intelligence.human_view: Think of the Dashboard as a shop window: it should show you, at a glance, how many people walked past and how many came in and stayed — clicks and joins, two real numbers, nothing else. If the window says "open the stats," the door behind it has to open onto the real stats room, not an old dusty storeroom — and there has to be a clear way back out, an X at the top, exactly where it was before. When Shawn is standing right there with you, live, you don't tell him to come back at noon — you do it now, because the schedule is a guide, not a gate. When you tap on a person, their card should open like a beautiful framed portrait, with everything about them and everything you can do with them in one place — never a tiny little box floating in the middle of nowhere. And the notes: the smart note is the short sweet version, the Naya note is the whole long letter — and the short one sits at the top in the simplest words, so anyone can get it in seconds.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a smart note is the short, sweet version of a story! A Naya note is the whole long story! A button is a promise: if it says open stats, it opens the stats! A business counts two things: how many people came, and how many stayed! And no more tiny little pop-up boxes! Everything pops up big and beautiful, right inside the frame!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — a smart note is the short sweet version, dear, and a Naya note is the whole long letter, with everything in it! A button is a promise, love: if it says open the stats, it must open the real stats, dear, not some old page! And the way back is always there, love — the little X at the top, right where it was! And nothing pops up tiny anymore, dear — everything fits beautifully inside the frame, like it was meant to be there!
intelligence.naya_view: Business board stats: clicks to the page and joins, real counts, never invented. Dashboard default: clicks and sales to NayaNet; Business board default: clicks to the page and joins. Say "claim your smart link", never "claim your name". "Open the stats" opens the live clicks/gauge view for that business or that space — same rule for both — render-proven at phone width and desktop. Stats view carries an X at the top center; clicking it returns to the previous screen, and the view stays formatted on return. Live with Shawn and doable now: do it now — the structure is a guideline, never a gate. Messenger plus, right side, aligned with the current: opens the sidebar tab or the instant message, then moves over. Info card: full framed, extraordinary — notes, instant messages and mail, match percentage, areas, connection, relevance, message / mail / Smart Meet / call, all from the card. Every pop-up fits INTO the frame, optimized to the viewport — the signature output. Smart note: essence, nutshell at the top (the human level), then child, then grandma, then the five areas, three to four sentences a section. Naya note: the full report, same format, however many sentences it takes — the default. Naya reads the Naya notes.
